subject: agentty
title: Three-trigger doom breaker with an always-on identical-SUCCESS-repeat cap that catches unknown local models
one_why: Beyond crush's single breaker: failing-repeat x3 (always), byte-identical succeeding-repeat x6 (EVERY model, motivated by a measured 80-repeat loop of a 22GB model behind a private gateway that the weak-model heuristic could not name), and a 25-turn runaway cap deliberately gated to weak models only; the break surfaces as a corrective final assistant turn, not a kill.

subject: agentty
title: Permission policy as a constexpr pure function with an exhaustive 48-cell compile-time proof - the build is the test runner
evidence: include/agentty/tool/policy.hpp:37-53 (pure constexpr (EffectSet x Profile) -> Decision), :66-90 (spec fn + static_assert loop over all 16x3 cells); single-source-of-truth doc :5-8
one_why: No other subject proves its trust matrix: a policy edit that breaks any cell fails the build at the breaking line, so the table can never silently drift from its spec - the cheapest correctness mechanism in the corpus, portable to any language with const-eval.

subject: agentty
title: Sandbox availability is a capability probe that runs the exact namespace the real command will use, not a `which`
evidence: src/tool/util/sandbox.cpp:66-98 (bwrap_can_sandbox unshares --user/--pid against /bin/true; fixes issue #21 false 'sandbox: active' on Ubuntu 24.04 AppArmor-restricted hosts), :24-35 (SBPL escape fail-closed); tests/sandbox_escape_test.cpp, tests/sandbox_parity_test.cpp; docs/SANDBOX.md:26-31
one_why: forge-norvialabs has the refuse-startup half; agentty adds the probe-fidelity half - `bwrap --version` proves only the binary exists, so the probe must replicate the real run's unshare set, and Auto-vs-On decide whether failure degrades or aborts; the SBPL path-escaping-with-fail-closed is a tested injection guard nobody else shows.

subject: agentty
title: Deep-ride compaction trigger justified in-cache: fire at ~95% because the retained prefix is a prompt-cache hit and every compaction resets it
evidence: src/runtime/app/update/stream.cpp:1062-1070 (threshold min(95%, window-20k) + cache rationale), :1086 max(tokens_in, est); cmd_factory.cpp:532-543 (summary slice capped at 150k so the summary request stays cheap on 1M windows)
one_why: Compaction cadence is reasoned about as total token burn (cache-hit prefix ~= free, compaction = summary request + cache reset), not as overflow fear - the trigger policy itself is cache-monotonic, and CompactionRecord stores before/after token counts so a compaction that reclaimed ~nothing is detectable (conversation.hpp:897-914).

subject: agentty
title: Reversible wire-only soft-trim under compaction: transcript never mutates, so overflow degrades to truncation instead of wedging the agent
evidence: src/runtime/app/cmd_factory.cpp:382-460 (soft_trim_to_ceiling: protects head, latest User, newest result; 'trim is REVERSIBLE ... no CompactionRecord is mutated'); stream.cpp:1057-1060 (compaction fails -> next turn ships via soft-trim); stream.cpp:405-428,794-799 (rapid-refill breaker, temporarily disabled, re-arms after ~10 quiet turns)
one_why: The loop never observes a wedge: mid-tool-burst overflow is handled by silently trimming the wire payload, LLM compaction stays a strictly-better optimization the user (or the idle trigger) runs at leisure, and the livelock breaker that disables auto-compact is temporary with a documented re-arm.

subject: agentty
title: Hooks and skills share one trust shape: content-hash-bound explicit approval that revokes on any byte change, and execution inside the same OS sandbox
evidence: include/agentty/tool/hooks.hpp:28-48 (unseen/changed hooks file does not run; `hooks approve` stores SHA-256; approved hooks run through the bwrap/sandbox-exec wrapper), skills.hpp:286-345 (body screened for documented injection patterns, approval keyed to body+declared-effects bytes)
one_why: There is no 'approve forever': modification invalidates consent, and the screening cites the arXiv 98k-skill study - even approved-but-compromised extension code stays workspace-confined, closing the auto-shell-on-first-read exfil vector the hooks surface normally implies.

subject: agentty
title: Air-gapped mode: agent runs on an offline host, bytes relay over `ssh -R 1080` SOCKS5 with TLS pinned end-to-end so the relay cannot MITM
evidence: src/airgap/airgap.cpp:1-30 (reverse SOCKS5, AGENTTY_SOCKS_PROXY injection, no per-host enumeration, exec() into ssh on POSIX); main.cpp:852,1210; README 'Air-gapped mode'
one_why: One command covers the whole air-gap workflow (dial, credential ferry with --setup + chmod 600, proxy env) without trusting the relay with plaintext - no other subject in the corpus addresses disconnected-host agenting at all.

subject: agentty
title: Quantized 1-hour cache anchor + one rolling 5-minute pin, capped at Anthropic's 4-breakpoint budget because a 5th evicts the system pin
evidence: tests/cache_anchor_test.cpp:1-13 (shape locked: anchor doesn't move when one turn is appended; <=2 message pins; short threads = rolling pair only); src/provider/anthropic/transport.cpp:87,346-401 (ttl 1h, silent-drop note, tools-array pin)
one_why: The quantization is what makes the anchor pay: a breakpoint that moves every turn is a cache miss every turn, and the <=4 discipline exists because exceeding Anthropic's breakpoint budget silently evicts the front (system-prompt) pin - a failure mode most subjects do not know they have.

subject: agentty
title: Byte-based token estimate is calibrated online by EMA against the provider's real usage counts before it gates compaction
evidence: src/runtime/app/update/stream.cpp:1729-1732 (next = 0.65*est_calibration + 0.35*sample), :1085 threshold compare uses est*calibration; include/agentty/domain/session.hpp:497; single estimator basis everywhere per include/agentty/domain/conversation.hpp:958-963
one_why: The raw bytes/3.5 guess fired compaction with 60k+ headroom on tool-heavy threads; one shared estimator plus a learned correction factor keeps the proactive (lagging-tokens_in problem) trigger honest without shipping a tokenizer.
